items.title: Towards Human-Machine Friendly Learning-Based Video Coding
items.organization: Beijing Key Laboratory of Advanced Information Science and Network Technology
details: Devised semantic-controlled VSR that combines patch-level blurring and residual shift in diffusion process and determines conditions by the
instance-centric and channel-wise semantics within and across clips during generation, enhancing content realism and temporal coherence.
Proposed semantic-guided inter-frame alignment that decouples video into instance, event and scene and conducts semantic-guided instance-
centric alignment among adjacent frames, gaining better performance when facing with large motion amplitude and background change.
Designed motion-driven temporal gate and texture-condition spatial gate based on the characteristic of residual coding, balancing the bit
allocation within video compression along the temporal axis.
